title: Garlicky Meatball Pasta Bake
description: Beef meatballs simmered in a garlic and chilli tomato sauce, tossed with penne pasta and baked under melted mozzarella and Parmesan.
ingredients: To serve: small handful of basil leaves, chopped red chilli (optional)
steps: Preheat oven to 200°C/180°C fan. Roll minced meat into walnut-sized balls. Fry over high heat in cooking spray for 5 minutes, turning to brown on all sides.
Blend tomatoes, garlic and chilli in a food processor until completely smooth; season.
Transfer sauce to a saucepan; bring to simmer; add cooked meatballs. Simmer 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook pasta for 12 minutes; drain; rinse with cold water.
Stir pasta through sauce; spoon into an ovenproof dish.
Tear mozzarella and distribute evenly on top; sprinkle with Parmesan; grind on pepper.
Bake 20 minutes until cheese is golden brown.
notes: Can be made vegetarian using Chickpea Meatballs (p.103) instead of beef.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
